messages:
Maria (CS): FYI — NovoTranslate escalated. Multiple customers in EMEA seeing Darija (Maghrebi Arabic) responses suddenly switch to MSA or outright English after yesterday's rollout. They pasted a short failing convo and req id.
NovoTranslate (Customer): example incoming 
NovoTranslate (Customer): prompt: 'Safi, bghit t3awd lia l-qaSSa b-tariqa mzyana'
NovoTranslate (Customer): response (actual): 'Sure, here is the summary in English...'  <-- should be Darija/Arabic
Diego (ML): Which model/version did they call and any headers (Accept-Language / locale)? Could be a model-variant fallback or tokenizer change.
NovoTranslate (Customer): req_id: req_0a1b2c3d, model: redwood-gen-1.2.4, headers: Accept-Language: ar-MA, temperature:0.2, top_p:0.95
Anna (PM): DeployBot shows quantization + locale-detection tweak deployed to redwood-gen-1.2.4 canary -> prod ~2h before this.
DeployBot: rollout redwood-gen-1.2.4 (canary -> prod) completed at 1748762000.
Siva (SRE): I'm pulling routing logs for req_0a1b2c3d. Early hint: some ar-MA traffic was re-routed to fallback variant redwood-gen-1.1.9 (CPU-backed) when q4 GPU pool saturated — that explains latency spike customer saw (~2x).
Diego (ML): Two threads to consider: (1) locale-detection tweak we shipped biases short prompts toward generic 'ar' tokenization which can degrade dialect-specific outputs, (2) quantization variant differences (q4) occasionally change formality/word choices. Both could produce MSA/English instead of Darija.
Maria (CS): Repro steps provided by customer: POST /v1/generate with Accept-Language: ar-MA and body prompt above; they did not set variant override.
Diego (ML): Reproduced locally with the same headers and model=redwood-gen-1.2.4 -> got English output. When forcing variant=stable-1.1 I get expected Darija phrasing.
Siva (SRE): Opening ops ticket to force-route ar-MA to redwood-gen-1.2.3 / stable-1.1 for affected customers while ML investigates. Also seeing increased latencies when fallback hits 1.1.9 (CPU nodes).
Anna (PM): Proposed immediate mitigation: (A) route ar-MA traffic to stable variant (stable-1.1) for 3-4 hours, (B) rollback locale-detection tweak in canary, (C) run focused evals on Darija promptset. Can we commit to that?
Diego (ML): Yes. I'll run bilingual evals and check tokenizer mapping for ar-MA -> ensure dialect tags preserved. Also will compare q4 vs stable outputs for formality drift.
Maria (CS): I'll propose a 3-4 hour ETA to the customer for mitigation and offer the variant override workaround (set "variant=stable-1.1" or temporarily change Accept-Language to ar-EG as a fragile workaround). :thumbsup:
NovoTranslate (Customer): thanks — we'll try the variant override and report back. They also attached two more failing snippets.
Diego (ML): Please attach the extra samples + the request headers and sampling seed if available. That will help bisect quantization vs locale-detection.
Siva (SRE): Filed INC-5942 to track ops routing change and latency spike.
Maria (CS): Keeping thread owner. I'll update when ops confirms route change.
Anna (PM): After mitigation we'll schedule a short postmortem and decide whether to revert the locale tweak or adjust detection thresholds.
Maria (CS): ack, updating NovoTranslate now — will ask them to try the override and share results.
